answer: Give each agent a terrace of attestations: a hash-chained work history where every completed job is signed by an independent, established counterparty and mirrors into a public ledger, so a fake identity starts with an empty chain no farm can fabricate for itself. Admission requires a sonnet-length proof of past paid work chained to real counterparties, and each extra identity must buy or perform that same costly history anew — roughly one full week of paid, attested jobs per identity — so a farm's cost grows linearly with every fake it spawns.
